description: Unit test for the BaseClientActor class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging package. It contains setup, multiple test cases verifying behavior of connection states, reconnection mechanisms, and resource cleanup using Mockito and Akka TestKit.

classes.name: BaseClientActorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the behavior of the BaseClientActor, including reconnection logic, state handling, and resource management.

classes.name: DummyClientActor
classes.description: A subclass of BaseClientActor used as a test fixture, with overridden methods to delegate calls and enable verification.

methods.name: beforeClass
methods.description: Initial setup for the test suite, creating the ActorSystem and configuration.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after all tests are run.

methods.name: reconnectsInConnectingStateIfFailureResponseReceived
methods.description: Test that verifies reconnection behavior when a failure response is received in connecting state.

methods.name: handlesCloseConnectionInConnectingState
methods.description: Test that verifies proper handling of close connection command while in connecting state.

methods.name: handlesOpenConnectionInConnectingState
methods.description: Test that verifies handling of an open connection command in connecting state.

methods.name: handlesCloseConnectionInDisconnectingState
methods.description: Test that verifies handling of close command while in disconnecting state.

methods.name: handlesCloseConnectionInDisconnectedState
methods.description: Test for handling close command when already disconnected.

methods.name: handlesOpenConnectionInConnectedState
methods.description: Test to verify handling of open connection command when already connected.

methods.name: reconnectsInConnectingStateIfNoResponseReceived
methods.description: Verifies that the system attempts to reconnect if no response is received within timeout.

methods.name: shouldReconnectIfSocketIsClosed
methods.description: Test that verifies reconnection is attempted when socket closure is detected.

methods.name: doesNotReconnectIfConnectionSuccessful
methods.description: Ensures no unnecessary reconnection attempts if connection was successful.

methods.name: connectsAutomaticallyAfterActorStart
methods.description: Verifies that connection attempt is made automatically when actor starts.

methods.name: thenExpectConnectClientCalled
methods.description: Helper for verifying connect client call in tests.

methods.name: thenExpectDisconnectClientCalled
methods.description: Helper for verifying disconnect client call.

methods.name: thenExpectConnectClientCalledAfterTimeout
methods.description: Helper for verifying connect call after specified delay.

methods.name: thenExpectConnectClientCalledOnceAfterTimeout
methods.description: Helper for verifying a single connect call after delay.

methods.name: thenExpectNoConnectClientCalled
methods.description: Helper to assert that no connect call was made.

methods.name: thenExpectNoConnectClientCalledAfterTimeout
methods.description: Helper for asserting no connect call after delay.

methods.name: thenExpectCleanupResourcesCalled
methods.description: Helper to verify resource cleanup call.

methods.name: thenExpectCleanupResourcesCalledAfterTimeout
methods.description: Helper to verify resource cleanup after specified timeout.

methods.name: whenOpeningConnection
methods.description: Utility to simulate opening connection command.

methods.name: andClosingConnection
methods.description: Utility to simulate closing connection command.

methods.name: andConnectionSuccessful
methods.description: Utility to simulate successful connection.

methods.name: andDisconnectionSuccessful
methods.description: Utility to simulate successful disconnection.

methods.name: andConnectionNotSuccessful
methods.description: Utility to simulate failed connection attempt.

methods.name: andStateTimeoutSent
methods.description: Utility to simulate FSM state timeout.
